newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares up at noon on cautious buying.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares up at noon on cautious buying.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index rose slightly at midday on Monday on cautious buying, largely on the back of a rebound on the A share market, brokers said.
The B share index gained 0.63 points or 0.40 percent to 157.96 on turnover of HK$36.70 million.
The A share index rallied 4.52 points or 1.00 percent to 458.14 on turnover of 4.06 billion yuan.
"The B shares rose in response to the A share advance," an analyst said.
Brokers said the B share market was likely to move in a narrow range for the rest of the session.
"Traders are waiting for the bulk of the B share firms to release their 1996 annual reports," the analyst said.
Less than half of the B share companies listed in Shenzhen have so far issued their annual results with the April 30 deadline approaching.
Conglomerate Shenzhen Zhonghao was the biggest gainer, up HK$0.26 or 6.34 percent to HK$4.36 on a single trade of 100 shares.
Refrigerator maker Hefei Meilin traded the most on 806,500 shares, up HK$0.13 or 2.1 percent to HK$6.28.
